usages.explain: Used in conversation. It's used to imply a negation, simply saying 「ちょっと」and then briefly summarizing the following sentence. It's used when one wants to avoid difficult topics.

examples.content: A：この絵、ここに掛けたらどう？B：そこはちょっとね。。。
examples.transcription: A：このえ、ここにかけたらどう？B：そこはちょっとね。。。
examples.mean: A: How about I hang this picture here? B: That's a bit. . .

examples.content: A：ご都合が悪いんですか。B：ええ、今日の午後はちょっと。。。
examples.transcription: A：ごつごうがわるいんですか。B：ええ、きょうのごごはちょっと。。。
examples.mean: A: Are you inconvenient? B: Yeah, a little bit this afternoon. . .

title: ちょっと => a little; a bit; slightly​
